name: flovira-workspace
description: Flovira Vue/React 设计器组件库及消费示例的 Bun 工作区

scripts.build:react-adapters: bun run --cwd react-adapters/lumen build && bun run --cwd react-adapters/antd build
scripts.build:demos: bun run --cwd examples/vue-element-plus build && bun run --cwd examples/vue-antdv build && bun run --cwd examples/vue-naive build && bun run --cwd examples/react build && bun run --cwd examples/react-lumen build && bun run --cwd examples/react-antd build
scripts.build:designer: bun run build:vue-designer && bun run build:react-designer && bun run build:react-adapters
scripts.build: bun run build:designer && bun run build:demos
scripts.test: bun run --cwd vue test && bun run --cwd react test && bun run --cwd react-adapters/lumen test && bun run --cwd react-adapters/antd test
scripts.check: bun run test && bun run build:designer
